settings.customCharacterStyle: Exact canonical brothers from CHARACTER_SHEETS. Never alter faces, skin tone, hair, outfits, props, age or height relationship.
settings.customProjectStructure: 16 continuous castle-puzzle scenes. Keys, symbols, doors and puzzle states persist. Scene N+1 starts from Scene N end frame. One speaker maximum.

movie.storyTitle: Roblox Brothers Adventure EP05 — ปราสาทปริศนา
movie.storySummary: สองพี่น้องเข้าสู่ปราสาทเกม ต้องตามหากุญแจสามชิ้น แก้ลำดับสัญลักษณ์ เปิดห้องลับ และใช้กุญแจรวมเปิดประตูยอดปราสาทก่อนกลับออกมา
movie.mainStoryPrompt: One continuous puzzle-castle adventure. Exact brother identities remain fixed. Each key, door, lever and symbol state must persist and cannot reset.

scenes.title: หน้าปราสาท
scenes.continuityStartState: Canonical brothers stand before closed castle gate; three empty key sockets visible without text.
scenes.mainAction: older brother studies the three empty sockets

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: ต้องหากุญแจสามอัน

scenes.imageDescription: HARD IDENTITY LOCK. Same canonical brothers, castle gate with three empty sockets, no labels.
scenes.videoPrompt: Character Sheets primary. Gentle push to sockets. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Brothers stand at gate; side door opens automatically revealing entry hall; all three sockets still empty.

scenes.title: เข้าห้องโถง
scenes.continuityStartState: Side door open; brothers at threshold; three sockets remain empty outside.
scenes.mainAction: they enter hall and notice three corridors

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: มีสามทางพอดี

scenes.imageDescription: Previous scene + Character Sheets. Same side door behind, three corridors ahead, no text signs.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear follow into hall. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Brothers stop at center of hall; left corridor selected first; other corridors remain untouched.

scenes.title: ห้องกระจก
scenes.continuityStartState: Brothers enter left corridor from central hall.
scenes.mainAction: younger brother spots real path between mirror decoys

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: เงานี้ไม่ตรง

scenes.imageDescription: Same brothers, mirror room with one correct open path; reflections must not create duplicate physical brothers.
scenes.videoPrompt: Over-shoulder puzzle reveal. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both stand at correct mirror opening; first bronze key visible on pedestal beyond.

scenes.title: กุญแจดอกแรก
scenes.continuityStartState: First bronze key on pedestal beyond correct opening.
scenes.mainAction: older brother picks up bronze key

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: ได้หนึ่งอัน

scenes.imageDescription: Same room. Older takes one bronze key; pedestal becomes empty; younger remains beside him.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium pickup shot. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Older brother carries bronze key; both turn back toward central hall; mirror pedestal empty.

scenes.title: ทางที่สอง
scenes.continuityStartState: Brothers return from left corridor; older carries bronze key; left corridor completed.
scenes.mainAction: younger brother points to center corridor floor symbols

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: ลองทางกลาง

scenes.imageDescription: Same central hall. Older still visibly carries bronze key. Center corridor selected; left remains completed.
scenes.videoPrompt: Pan from key to center corridor. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both stand at center-corridor entrance; three floor symbols visible in sequence.

scenes.title: จำลำดับ
scenes.continuityStartState: Three floor symbols visible ahead; bronze key remains with older brother.
scenes.mainAction: older brother points through symbol sequence once

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: วงกลม ดาว สามเหลี่ยม

scenes.imageDescription: Preserve bronze key and identities. Symbols only, no readable words.
scenes.videoPrompt: Top-down tilt across symbols. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Sequence established; both ready to step on first circle tile.

scenes.title: เหยียบให้ถูก
scenes.continuityStartState: Both ready at circle tile; sequence known.
scenes.mainAction: they cross circle, star, triangle in order
scenes.imageDescription: Same symbol corridor; activated tiles remain glowing behind them in correct order; older still carries bronze key.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear tracking across three tiles. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both reach far alcove; second silver key appears; all three symbol tiles remain activated.

scenes.title: กุญแจดอกสอง
scenes.continuityStartState: Second silver key in alcove; older already carries bronze key.
scenes.mainAction: younger brother picks up silver key

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: ตอนนี้สองอัน

scenes.imageDescription: Same brothers. Younger carries silver key; older carries bronze key. Alcove pedestal empty after pickup.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium two-shot showing both keys. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Older holds bronze key, younger holds silver key; both head back toward central hall.

scenes.title: ทางสุดท้าย
scenes.continuityStartState: Brothers back in hall carrying bronze and silver keys; first two corridors complete.

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: เหลือทางสุดท้าย

scenes.imageDescription: Both keys remain visible with correct brother. Right corridor only unfinished path.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear follow into right corridor. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Brothers arrive at room with four rotating blocks and one locked chest.

scenes.title: หมุนบล็อก
scenes.continuityStartState: Four rotating blocks and locked chest ahead; bronze/silver keys still carried.
scenes.mainAction: younger brother aligns block arrows toward chest

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: หันเข้าหากล่อง

scenes.imageDescription: Same room. Four symbol blocks rotate into one alignment; keys remain with brothers.
scenes.videoPrompt: Gentle arc around puzzle. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: All four blocks aligned; chest lock glows open; chest still closed.

scenes.title: กุญแจดอกสาม
scenes.continuityStartState: Blocks aligned; chest unlocked but closed.
scenes.mainAction: older opens chest and lifts gold key

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: ครบสามแล้ว

scenes.imageDescription: Same aligned blocks. Chest opens once. Older now holds bronze plus gold key; younger holds silver.
scenes.videoPrompt: Close chest opening then key reveal. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Chest remains open and empty; three keys are visibly carried; brothers turn toward exit.

scenes.title: กลับประตูใหญ่
scenes.continuityStartState: Three keys carried; all puzzle rooms completed.
scenes.mainAction: brothers return to main gate sockets

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: ใส่ให้ครบเลย

scenes.imageDescription: Gate with same three empty sockets. Bronze/silver/gold keys visible with brothers.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear follow to sockets. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Brothers stand before sockets; older holds bronze and gold; younger holds silver; gate closed.

scenes.title: ใส่กุญแจครบ
scenes.continuityStartState: Three keys held before three empty sockets.
scenes.mainAction: they insert all three keys into matching sockets

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: พร้อม เปิดเลย

scenes.imageDescription: Keys move from hands into three sockets; no key remains in hand after insertion.
scenes.videoPrompt: Close sequence across sockets. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: All three keys locked in sockets; main gate fully opens to rooftop stairway.

scenes.title: ขึ้นยอดปราสาท
scenes.continuityStartState: Main gate open; keys remain installed; rooftop stairs ahead.

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: เกือบถึงแล้ว

scenes.imageDescription: Same gate open behind, keys remain in sockets, brothers climbing one continuous stairway.
scenes.videoPrompt: Upward rear follow. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both reach rooftop platform; return portal inactive beside final plain button.

scenes.title: เปิดทางกลับ
scenes.continuityStartState: Both on rooftop; portal inactive; final button beside it.
scenes.mainAction: older brother presses button and portal opens

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: จบปริศนาแล้ว

scenes.imageDescription: Same rooftop. One button press activates one return portal. No readable text.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium button-to-portal reveal. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Portal fully open; both brothers stand side-by-side facing it.

scenes.title: กลับจากปราสาท
scenes.continuityStartState: Both side-by-side facing open rooftop portal.

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: ไปด่านต่อไปกัน

scenes.imageDescription: Exact canonical brothers enter together; castle remains behind with solved state intact.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear follow into portal. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Portal closes after both pass; episode complete.
